rationale: S-0052-01 proposes an AMPA per-synapse conductance sweep on the t0052 minimal DSGC to close the 30-150x peak-rate gap. The from-scratch DSGC family (t0052 - t0059) has been pivoted away from in favour of the deposited Bed A (t0008 / t0020) and Bed B (t0024) substrates, where biological grounding is stronger and the recent project arc (t0067 - t0076) operates exclusively. The from-scratch family is stuck in a binary regime (single-spike trivial DSI or full-suppression zero DSI) and an AMPA conductance sweep at fixed scalar gabaMOD inhibition is unlikely to escape this trap. The AMPA / NMDA / GABA conductance question is being answered on Bed B inside t0078's bundled MOBO. Rejecting as stale relative to the project's current critical path.
